title: Salade Régalade
notes: This is Chef Alain Rayé's take on a Caesar Salad. The piling of the warm seafood on top of the already more tender baby romaine lettuce results in a comforting, wholesome dish that is still light like a salad.

ingredientSections.heading: Vinaigrette
items: Salt and white pepper to taste

ingredientSections.heading: Salad
items: 15 Small Calamari cleaned and left whole
¼ Cup Diced bacon, cooked and drained
A good Pinch of piment d'Espelette (available from specialty stores) or sweet Hungarian paprika

methodSections.heading: The Vinaigrette
steps: Combine all the vinaigrette ingredients in a blender and pulse until they emulsify. This dressing will keep for up to a week in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

methodSections.heading: The Salad
steps: Preheat a pan over a high heat and add the oil.
Sauté the prawns for about 3 minutes and remove from the pan.
In the same hot pan sauté the onion, calamari and bacon together.
At the last minute add the tomato and green onion.
Season with salt and a pinch of piment d'Espelette.
In a bowl mix the baby romaine with around 5 tbsp of the vinaigrette and toss loosely. Do not do this before cooking the warm ingredients as the vinaigrette will burn the romaine.

methodSections.heading: Serving Up
steps: Pile the dressed romaine in the centre of large bowl plates.
Stack the cooked ingredients on top of the lettuce and let tumble down the sides.
Crown the dish with the prawns.
Sprinkle parmesan over the top and add the croutons.
